record.title: Derive and pin the finite stock ADC table-loop transcript
record.intent: Turn the conditional static loop analysis into an independently checkable immutable experiment input.
requirements: Use Kotlin tooling to read the pinned stock ELF without modifying it and validate table symbols, relocations, loop bound and command-construction instruction assumptions.
Derive exactly 440 ordered words from the first110 entries of the two111-entry tables, both modes and both writes per call.
Exclude post-loop and writable-state operations; distinguish software predictions from runtime observations and hardware semantics.
Document a bounded versioned guest transcript protocol and emit deterministic stock and private-control fixtures with hashes.
Validate independent agreement with captured static transcript evidence and retain the original index self-reference failure separately.
Deferred pending whole-subsystem static contract recovery; the decision gate must re-evaluate this exact transcript scope before execution.
acceptance: Reproducible derivation, exact bounds and input integrity are independently verified; no guest run or new modeled response in this task.
Commit and push derived-input tooling and evidence before implementing the guest consumer.
